// diagnostic

E0314

{names} of this tuple, so `({pattern})` can't bind it

What

{names} of this tuple, so `({pattern})` can't bind it

Why

Tuples destructure by member name, never by position; this tuple's members are {members}

Fix

Write `({members}) :: …` to bind by name, or `{ member: local, … } :: …` to rename

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0314: tests/ui/tuple_destructure_positional.stderr.

Error [E0314]: `head` and `tail` aren't members of this tuple, so `(head, tail)` can't bind it
  --> tuple_destructure_positional.jet:2:5
    |
  2 |     (head, tail) :: (before: 10, after: 20)
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Tuples destructure by member name, never by position; this tuple's members are `after` and `before`
 Fix: Write `(after, before) :: …` to bind the members by name, or `{ after: …, before: … } :: …` to give them new names
